html:
SMTO-CMP-0030 — Newer results replaced the result the AI used to finish

GUID: 6bbb417f-7f66-44ed-907d-6e0d5d763e6b
Slug: completion-stale-evidence
Domain: CMP · Subsystem: cmp

What happened

  • The AI tried to finish using a result that later steps have since replaced or contradicted. SMTO won't finish on outdated information, so it asked the AI to use the latest result. Earlier work is kept.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. If the task still shows Running, wait. SMTO has asked the AI to look again and finish using the newest result. Finishing on the newest result means the task reflects what is actually true now.
  2. If the task stops as Partial · resumable, expand the task and look at the last few steps to see which result is newest. The later step that replaced the old result shows the most recent state.
  3. Send a message asking SMTO to check the current state and finish. Don't ask it to redo changes the steps show as done. A fresh check confirms the result without repeating changes.

What success looks like

  • The task finishes as Completed, based on a check made after its last change.

If it still fails

  • Check whether the earlier action already happened before asking for it again. Open Technical details, select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't repeat changes until a fresh check shows they're missing.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Direct completion was rejected because the proposed operation receipt is stale, or a later retained result supersedes or conflicts with the cited evidence.

What this means

  • Direct completion finds the proposed operation evidence stale, superseded or contradicted by later retained results. Completion checks consume retained evidence and the effective guard policy; they do not execute work. A rejected declaration preserves the answer and successful receipts, and only the original operation evidence establishes effects.

Why this can happen

  • Direct completion finds the proposed operation evidence stale, superseded or contradicted by later retained results.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect supersedes/conflicts and the current operation history before selecting eligible evidence.

How to fix it

  • Inspect the supersedes/conflicts fields and stale_reason for the operation named in the completion.direct_rejected event. Observe the current state again and complete with the current receipt; historical receipts remain valid execution facts and must not be discarded or replayed.
  • Refresh the relevant observation and cite its current receipt.

Retry and execution caution

  • Inspect and reconcile authoritative state before repeating a mutation. Do not blindly retry.

How to verify the fix

  • Completion uses the authoritative current evidence without discarding historical execution facts.

What not to do

  • Do not repeat a mutation while the earlier outcome or current owner is unresolved.

Technical notes

  • Completion checks consume retained evidence and the effective guard policy; they do not execute work. A rejected declaration preserves the answer and successful receipts, and only the original operation evidence establishes effects.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.

Do not confuse with / related errors

  • SMTO-EXE-0004 — Execution outcome is unknown
